name: Chin-Up
steps: Grip a pull-up bar with palms facing you about shoulder-width apart and hang with arms straight.
Engage your shoulder blades downward and brace your core with legs straight or ankles crossed.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs until your chin clears the top of the bar.
Lower yourself under control until your arms straighten back into a full hang.
tips: Keep your neck long as you approach the bar instead of craning your chin up.
Avoid swinging your legs or kipping to start the pull.
